# ISI India (Industrial Security & Intelligence India Pvt. Ltd.)

> Premier Enterprise Security, AI Surveillance, Cash Logistics & Integrated Facility Management in India.

ISI Security is an ISO 9001:2015 and PSARA-certified enterprise security and integrated facility management organization operating across 18+ Indian states with 25+ years of operational excellence.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.isisecurity.in/): Enterprise security solutions, C4i command center intelligence, and integrated facility management.
- [About Us](https://www.isisecurity.in/about): 25+ year legacy, leadership team, certifications, and nationwide operational footprint.
- [Capabilities](https://www.isisecurity.in/capabilities): Physical guarding, autonomous drones, AI video analytics, and command center integration.
- [Offerings](https://www.isisecurity.in/offerings): Complete service stack across Security Services and Facility Management.
- [Verticals](https://www.isisecurity.in/verticals): Tailored security frameworks for Banking/BFSI, GCC & IT Parks, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Education, and Retail.
- [ISI Academy](https://www.isisecurity.in/academy): Skill development, PSARA training, and CDAC-aligned technical security programs.
- [Technology Courses](https://www.isisecurity.in/courses): Certified cybersecurity, AI surveillance, IoT, and enterprise security courses.
- [Security Insights & Blog](https://www.isisecurity.in/blog): Threat intelligence and operational security guides for enterprise leaders.
- [Careers](https://www.isisecurity.in/career): Nationwide career opportunities in security operations, SOC monitoring, and facility management.
- [Contact Us](https://www.isisecurity.in/contact): 24/7 enterprise security consultation and pan-India branch network.

## Specialized Solutions

- [Security Services](https://www.isisecurity.in/services/security): Manned guarding, electronic security, remote monitoring, and Executive Protection Services.
- [Integrated Facility Management](https://www.isisecurity.in/services/integrated-facility-management): Hard FM, Soft FM, preventive maintenance, and ESG energy optimization.
- [Command Center (C4i)](https://www.isisecurity.in/commandcenter): 24/7 centralized surveillance, IoT sensor fusion, and rapid incident response.
- [Cash Logistics (CIT)](https://www.isisecurity.in/cashlogistics): RBI-compliant Cash-in-Transit, ATM replenishment, and biometric vaulting.
- [Secure Value Logistics](https://www.isisecurity.in/securevaluelogistics): Bullion, diamond, jewellery, and high-value asset transit protection.
- [School Safety](https://www.isisecurity.in/schoolsafety): K-12 student safety, bus GPS telemetry, and visitor verification.
- [Campus Safety](https://www.isisecurity.in/campussafety): University and residential campus security ecosystems.
- [GCC & IT Parks](https://www.isisecurity.in/gccitparks): Zero-trust physical security for technology parks and Global Capability Centers.
